findings.topic: Strict local span and observer closure
findings.conclusion: K must be exactly 1. GDN and its two exact one-dimensional F32 slices remain private; only their two own dense F32 CONT producers can consume them. Both CONTs may be OUTPUT and have later real readers. Only exact zero-offset contiguous endpoint RESHAPE metadata can intervene; arbitrary View/NONE, Cast, CPY or math declines. The cold src and view_src ancestry scan rejects every extra observer of the packed buffer/private slices, including leaf metadata. Node OP_NONE is conservatively declined; normal raw inputs are leaves. The chosen count stops after both CONTs, so later endpoint users continue normally.

findings.topic: Bound writes, aliases and real allocation owners
findings.conclusion: Hot qualification retains the original typed metadata/NVIDIA/grid/full-packed allocation check, then checks nine current strided ranges: six actual inputs, full packed allocation and both real CONT outputs. Checked extents, element alignment, buffer native type/device, actual owner base/capacity and address overflow are required. Both outputs must be disjoint from all reads, packed and each other; the old cache same-s0 exception is explicitly tightened by the new pairwise checks. Read/read aliases remain allowed. The full packed allocation is still required; this is not a packed-workspace size reduction. Raw leaf addresses are additionally checked against the now-unwritten packed tail.

findings.topic: Unchanged numerical operations and Y path
findings.conclusion: The original fused_cache entry and original TV/TB dispatch/kernel are reused. K=1 selects keep_rs=false, so the cache slot_stride=0 is unused in mathematical stores. The only change is state_d pointing at the actual final state CONT allocation. The same F32 state bits previously went through same-type contiguous cudaMemcpyAsync; no rounding/nonlinear/reduction is deleted. The original score store to packed prefix and original ggml_cuda_dup(score CONT) still execute. K>1, missing endpoints and rejected bound aliases retain the old GDN/cache/copy path.

findings.topic: Cold liveness, qualifier lifetime and failure behavior
findings.conclusion: Cold collection clears every GDN slot-1 stamp before the disable-fusion return and sets it only after the closed pattern and seven dependency registrations succeed. Six actual input storage roots plus packed score source remain live through the terminal CONT. Existing allocator-backed metadata, exception/failure handling, measured reserve and actual reserve paths are reused. Metadata probe and real Invocation independently build their own graph; finish_bind only installs current buffer addresses/views and does not change source edges. Hot qualification repeats actual bounds rather than treating the stamp as permission. Original op_params slot zero remains K and is the only slot read by GDN mathematics. There is no immutable Program destination pointer or new pending state.

findings.topic: Record/Commands complexity is bounded but not constant
findings.conclusion: Hot encode does not rescan graph-node users or view ancestry. It repeats the local split span and fixed nine-range owner checks, plus O(L) current raw leaf range checks per matching GDN. Cold closure costs O(G*(N+L+ancestry)) across G eligible GDN nodes, with the same existing dependency metadata allocator budget. Commands therefore still has a leaf scan; it must not be described as pure O(1) hot work or as eliminating every full-collection iteration. Captured replay uses the existing recorded command artifact and its existing lifetime gates.

findings.topic: Meaningful appended public Graph regression, with honest oracle limits
findings.conclusion: The single appended test covers K1 T1 and T3, B2, unequal cyclic head mapping, per-channel decay, two distinct Invocation input/output sets, RequireCapture preparations before both submits, both Completion objects alive while reading, both endpoints published and actually read by Copy, exact native F32 comparison, independent F64 recurrence tolerance and old-state bytes retained. Existing K>1/typed/recurrent cases remain unchanged. It does not force a legacy state-copy reference: direct_reference uses the same current provider and can also use the new route. Independent recurrence and source invariance are the separate guarantees. It also does not assert a physical fusion counter or test all alias-decline cases; actual trace is necessary to establish state-copy removal.
